decision.summary: NO_ACTION: no open positions to manage, and BTC is still hovering above 78.5k/78k support without a confirmed breakdown or rebound.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Account state shows no open positions and recent trade history is coherent, so there is nothing to close or reduce; the May 15 take-profit cooldown has reset with the new UTC day. The latest Beecthor transcript and summary still frame 78.5k/78k as the key support that should either hold for a bounce toward 82.6k/85.5k or break with confirmation for a bearish extension. At 06:00 UTC Binance spot is about 79,027, essentially flat versus the overnight board and still sitting just above support, so the range/no-trade gate is more appropriate than forcing a directional daily. The nearest downside market, will-bitcoin-dip-to-78k-on-may-16 Yes, is only about 0.16 and lacks the required breakdown confirmation; the nearest upside market, will-bitcoin-reach-80k-on-may-16 Yes, is only about 0.19 and lacks a confirmed rebound and acceptance back above 80k. With neither side cleanly confirmed, there is no valid edge.
